note: Export presets for npm run reel -- --export <name>[,<name>...] and npm run export. w and h are the delivered frame. A preset with reframe true (4:5 and 1:1) is its own version of the reel: the frame follows your face up and down (kit/facewindow.cjs) and every caption, title, graphic and b-roll is laid out again inside it (kit/export-frame.cjs); y0 is only where the frame sits when no face is found. file is the end of the file name (reel-v1-feed-4x5.mp4) and use is the plain label Studio shows. safe is the platform's UI zones in pixels of the delivered frame (profile row, caption and buttons at the bottom, the action column on the right). The layout pass keeps every title, caption and graphic inside the safe rect, and npm run verify -- <job> --export <name> checks it. The zones are approximate, taken from each platform's published safe-zone guidance; check them again before a paid campaign. maxSec is the longest upload the preset allows (a longer reel is trimmed, with a warning); videoKbps caps the video bitrate.
